framework.summary: Large developers must produce, follow and publish a safety and security protocol, and publish changes within 30 days.
framework.quote: Produce, implement, follow, and conspicuously publish a safety and security protocol.

transparency_report.summary: Large developers must publish a transparency report on risk assessments at least once every 90 days.
transparency_report.quote: Not less than once every 90 days, produce and conspicuously publish a transparency report

incident_reporting.summary: The protocol must state when and to whom the developer will report incidents; the bill sets no reporting duty or deadline itself.
incident_reporting.quote: The conditions under which the large developer will report an incident relevant to a critical risk

imminent_risk_reporting.summary: The bill sets no shorter reporting window for imminent risks.

third_party_audit.summary: Large developers must hire a reputable third-party auditor at least once per year to assess protocol compliance, and publish the report.
third_party_audit.quote: not less than once per year, a large developer shall retain a reputable third-party auditor to produce a report

whistleblower.summary: Large developers may not retaliate against employees who report critical risks to authorities; employees may sue.
whistleblower.quote: A large developer shall not discharge, threaten, or otherwise discriminate against an employee

registration.summary: The bill sets no registration or licensing requirement.

shutdown.summary: The bill requires no shutdown or kill-switch capability.

compute_threshold.summary: Coverage is set by the cost of training compute ($5,000,000.00 for one model), not by operations count.
compute_threshold.quote: model with a quantity of computing power that costs not less than $5,000,000.00

revenue_threshold.summary: No revenue test; a large developer also needs $100,000,000.00 of compute spending on models in the prior 12 months.
revenue_threshold.quote: total quantity of computing power that costs not less than $100,000,000.00

harm_threshold.summary: Critical risk means death or serious injury to more than 100 people, or more than $1,000,000,000.00 in damages, from listed incident kinds.
harm_threshold.quote: more than 100 people, or will result in more than $1,000,000,000.00 in damages to rights in money or property

penalties.summary: The Attorney General may sue for a civil fine up to $1,000,000.00 per violation of the publication, reporting and audit duties (Sec. 7 and 9), plus injunctive relief; whistleblower violations carry a fine up to $500.00.
penalties.quote: A civil fine of not more than $1,000,000.00 per violation.

effective_date.summary: The developer duties begin on January 1, 2026.
effective_date.quote: Beginning on January 1, 2026, a large developer shall do all of the following

notes: Whistleblower civil fine is only $500.00 (Sec. 11(7)); not in penalties summary.
